author: Joel P Diaz-Fong

steps.title: Prepare Participant for Scanning
steps.instruction: Ensure the participant is prepared to guarantee a high-quality 3D scan.

substeps.instruction: Identify key anatomical landmarks (fiducials), such as the bridge of the nose and ears, and ensure they have an unobstructed view.
Verify correct electrode placement according to the EEG system and ensure no electrodes are obstructed by hair.
Identify and cover any reflective surfaces in the scanning environment using non-reflective stickers or a wax marker.

steps.title: Import 3D Mesh Model
steps.instruction: Open MeshLab software and import the 3D triangular mesh file.

steps.title: Initialize PickPoints Tool
steps.instruction: Open the PickPoints tool to begin localizing fiducial and electrode coordinates.

substeps.instruction: Select the PickPoints icon in the toolbar or navigate to Edit > PickPoints.

steps.title: Set Up Point Names
steps.instruction: Define the labels for the points to be localized before selection.

substeps.instruction: Manually enter each electrode label as a Point Name, or load an existing .pptpl template via Template Controls > Load.

steps.title: Localize Fiducials and Electrodes
steps.instruction: Identify and mark the coordinates of fiducials and electrodes on the mesh model.

substeps.instruction: Locate the fiducial (e.g., nasion (NAS), left helix-tragus junction (LHJ), and right helix-tragus junction (RHJ)) or electrode on the mesh.
Right-click the location to place a green pin; verify that XYZ coordinates appear next to the Point Name.
To rotate the mesh, unselect PickPoints, drag the model, and then reselect PickPoints to continue.
Select electrodes point-by-point following the Point Names column, aiming for the center of the electrode so the pin is perpendicular to the scalp.

steps.title: Save Coordinates and Model
steps.instruction: Export the localized points and optionally save a visual record.

substeps.instruction: Select Save at the upper right-hand corner of the PickPoints tool to save coordinates as an XML formatted picked point (.pp) file.
Optional: Save a template of Point Names as a .pptpl file via Template Controls > Save.
Optional: Save a snapshot of the mesh with green pins via File > Save snapshot (remove model texture for anonymity if needed).

steps.title: Process Extracted Coordinates
steps.instruction: Convert the saved XML data into a usable format and coordinate space.

substeps.instruction: Extract coordinates from the .pp XML file and convert them to text.
Use the fiducials as reference points to convert the coordinates from the mesh model's space to a standard coordinate space.
